purpose: Materialize the linear conservation-equation family implied by the declared A1.1 assumptions, while preserving gauge/IC/regularity blockers and without asserting that the candidate is the canonical RLL perturbation theory.

source_authority.title: IDECAMB: an implementation of interacting dark energy cosmology in CAMB
source_authority.boundary: External conservation equations constrain implementation form; they do not derive RLL microphysics.

source_authority.title: Consistent Initial Conditions for Early Modified Gravity in Effective Field Theory
source_authority.boundary: The Taylor-series/constraint methodology is transferable guidance; Horndeski/EFT-specific field equations and coefficients are not imported into RLL.

notation.A_B_HL: scalar metric perturbations in the IDECAMB convention

general_gauge_candidate.C01_DELTA_S: delta_s' + 3 H (c_s2-w) delta_s + (1+w)(k^2 theta_s + k B + 3 H_L') + 9 H^2 (c_s2-c_a2)(1+w) theta_s = 0
general_gauge_candidate.C02_THETA_S: theta_s' + H(1-3 c_s2) theta_s - c_s2 delta_s/(1+w) - A = 0
general_gauge_candidate.derivation: IDECAMB equations (4.4)-(4.5) under Q=deltaQ=f=0 and sigma_s=0; c_s2=1 is the existing A1.1 candidate assumption.

synchronous_projection_reference.C01_DELTA_S: delta_s' + 3 H(c_s2-w)delta_s + (1+w)(k v_s + h'/2) + 9 H^2(c_s2-c_a2)(1+w) v_s/k = 0
synchronous_projection_reference.C02_V_S: v_s' + H(1-3 c_s2)v_s - c_s2 k delta_s/(1+w) = 0

regularity_obligation.source_warning: The implementation reference explicitly warns that direct fluid pressure-perturbation evolution can become unstable near phantom-divide behavior; A1.1 must prove numerical regularity for its own w(a).
rules: do not insert a hidden epsilon into 1+w
record min_abs_1_plus_w and conditioning diagnostics over the preregistered sweep
detect subtraction collapse in the existing double-precision background representation
a failure of direct standard-fluid regularity blocks solver handoff but does not by itself falsify every alternative regularization/PPF representation

initial_condition_obligation.method: derive a model-consistent super-horizon series from the frozen RLL equations and constraints, using k*tau as expansion parameter; do not copy GR ICs by default
required_checks: Weyl/metric-potential regularity or the corresponding RLL gauge-invariant diagnostic
stability over the declared early-time domain

boundary: Equation-family materialization is not canonical gauge selection, initial-condition closure, solver implementation, observational evidence, or confirmation of RLL.
